newsitem.title: CANADA: Revenue Properties unit gets credit line.
newsitem.headline: Revenue Properties unit gets credit line.

text.p: Revenue Properties Co Ltd on Monday said its Pan Pacific Development unit secured a US$200 million credit facility for property acquistion purposes.

Pan Pacific reached the agreement with Prudential Securities Credit Corp. The facility will provide Pan Pacific with bridge financing for the acquisition of additional shopping centers in the western United States.
Revenue Properties said the commitment is subject to customary conditions including preparation and negotiation of a definitive loan agreement.
